skill.name: claude-handoff
skill.description: Create a concise handoff summary and start a fresh Claude background agent with the current work context.
skill.summary: Hand off active coding work to a new background Claude agent without losing context.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable source code, network calls, or file writes. One static finding is a real external command instruction because it asks the assistant to launch a Claude background process with generated prompt text; the second is only option documentation.

remediation.issue: The command example passes generated handoff text as a shell argument.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to invoke the CLI with argument arrays or safe quoting, and avoid shell interpolation for the handoff summary.

content.value_statement: Long coding sessions can lose momentum when context grows too large or work must move to another agent. This skill creates a focused handoff summary and starts a fresh background Claude agent with the right context.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes the current conversation for a fresh agent
Starts a Claude background agent with a descriptive name
Tailors the handoff to the user's provided focus area
Suggests relevant skills for the next agent to use
Instructs the assistant to redact sensitive information
References existing artifacts instead of duplicating long content
limitations: Requires access to the Claude CLI background agent feature
Does not verify that the new agent completes the work
Depends on the assistant to redact sensitive information correctly
May need careful shell quoting for summaries with special characters

use_cases.title: Continue a long coding task
use_cases.description: Move a complex implementation to a fresh background agent while keeping the key decisions, files, and next steps clear.

use_cases.title: Delegate follow-up investigation
use_cases.description: Start a separate agent to research open questions without blocking the current session.

use_cases.title: Prepare a clean session transition
use_cases.description: Create a focused handoff when a session is overloaded, interrupted, or ready for parallel work.

prompt_templates.title: Basic handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a fresh agent for the same task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use claude-handoff to continue this task in a fresh background agent.

prompt_templates.title: Focused bug handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Move debugging work to a new agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Use claude-handoff with the focus: investigate the failing login test and propose the smallest safe fix.

prompt_templates.title: Parallel research handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Delegate investigation while keeping the current session active
prompt_templates.prompt: Use claude-handoff with the focus: research the current API client behavior and report the likely migration risks.

prompt_templates.title: Artifact-aware implementation handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Continue work using existing plans or diffs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use claude-handoff with the focus: continue the implementation using the current diff and referenced plan, without repeating existing artifact content.

output_examples.input: Hand off this refactor to a new agent.
output_examples.output: A background Claude agent is started with a short summary of the refactor goal, current files, completed work, remaining steps, and suggested skills.

output_examples.input: Continue debugging the failing tests in a fresh session.
output: The handoff names the test failure and recent observations.
It references existing logs or diffs instead of copying them fully.
It redacts secrets before passing the summary to the new agent.

best_practices: Give a clear focus argument so the new agent starts with the right objective.
Reference plans, issues, commits, and diffs by path or URL instead of copying long text.
Review the handoff summary for secrets before launching a background agent.
anti_patterns: Do not include API keys, passwords, tokens, or personal data in the handoff summary.
Do not use this when a direct answer in the current session is enough.
Do not rely on the background agent without checking its results before acting.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It summarizes the current conversation and starts a fresh Claude background agent with that summary as the prompt.

faq.question: Does it save a handoff file?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs the assistant to launch a background agent instead of saving the summary.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed for workflows that use the Claude CLI and Claude Code background agents.

faq.question: Is sensitive data protected automatically?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to redact sensitive data, but users should still review summaries before launch.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when a task needs a fresh context window, background continuation, or parallel investigation.

faq.question: What are the main risks?
faq.answer: The main risks are unsafe shell quoting and accidental inclusion of sensitive information in the handoff prompt.
